name: Identify scams
description: The adversary tries to identify scams, which could negatively affect them financially or result in de-anonymization.

subtechniques.name: Avoid bad OpSec practices by DNM
subtechniques.description: If Darknet markets propose ‘bad OPSEC’ practices, such as providing a phone number, they should be avoided because they might be scam.

subtechniques.name: Avoid standard escrow services
subtechniques.description: To prevent the vendor from running away with your money.

subtechniques.name: Be aware of skimmers
subtechniques.description: Check for creditcard scammers when paying offline to prevent financial losses.

subtechniques.name: Only use funds you are comfortable losing
subtechniques.description: To prevent losing money you cannot miss.
